permissions.purpose: Receive invoice events so sales tax is added as soon as a draft invoice is created or changed.
Read draft invoices and their line items to calculate sales tax.
Write the calculated sales tax onto each line of draft invoices.
Read the customer's shipping or billing address, which decides the tax rate.
Read each product's tax code or tax_category to know if it is taxable.

content_security_policy.purpose: Loads and saves the states you collect sales tax in, on the Tax Engine server.
